Vehicle graphics care

Prepare properly. Protect the finished graphics.

Specialist cleaning before installation and ceramic protection afterwards help vehicle graphics look their best and remain easier to maintain.

Before graphics

Pre-installation clean & decontamination

Remove road film, tar and bonded contamination before graphics or wrap installation. A properly prepared surface gives the installer a cleaner foundation to work with.

Book decontamination Discuss vehicle graphics ↗
After graphics

Wrap and graphics ceramic protection

Add a suitable ceramic coating after installation to improve water behaviour, simplify regular cleaning and help protect the appearance of vinyl graphics and vehicle wraps.

Request a protection quote Visit Race Car Graphics ↗

Professional vehicle care in Norwich

Cleaning, correction and detailing under one roof.

Keep your vehicle clean, comfortable and well presented with professional vehicle valeting in Norwich. Choose a complete interior and exterior valet, deep interior cleaning, soft-top care or exterior trim rejuvenation.

For regular maintenance, explore our hand car washing services. If the paint needs greater clarity and gloss, compare machine polishing, paint correction and ceramic coating packages. Prefer to complete the work yourself? Our valet bay hire in Norwich provides an indoor workspace with specialist equipment for public and trade users.
